plan.archetype: Early attack tempo into poison and dexterity scaling
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with upgraded poison scaling, reliable Weak, and strong block or a defensive potion ready for the post-kill explosion.
plan.summary: Improve starter damage immediately, then build poison scaling and efficient defense. Take elites selectively after gaining damage and potions. Preserve health; killing Giant still requires surviving its explosion.

plan.archetype: Skull-enhanced poison scaling with efficient defense and Weak

plan.archetype: Free attack tempo supporting Skull poison and dexterity defense

plan.archetype: Skull poison scaling with free attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish defensive powers early. Reapply poison after phase resets; avoid unnecessary Enrage triggers. Preserve health and emergency potions for the consecutive second boss.
